components.summary: Dispatch read, change, map, target and release commands. Preserve exits and verification defaults; emit the same typed verdict as text or one JSON line, with stable advice identifiers.
responsibilities: parse command lines and dispatch them to their owners Confirmation writes format 2 pointers and upgrades the map after all confirmed pointers are current. Model-running commands accept jobs 1-32, default to min(4, CPUs), and retain explicit --jobs 1 serial execution; the hidden verify alias keeps its existing surface. The change --verbose flag displays exact selected pytest commands.
show complete owners, closest owners, target changes, Mermaid and reviews in read; folded child names lead to full component views
annotate planned target breakage and ARCH lines in check, change and release; show fingerprint-format reminders in change

run release with the system root counted and optional whole-suite shards; reject expired debts in strict release checks and display explicit debt deadlines; reject already-applied committed targets and target deletions not staged, preserving the warning for real open targets
run bound tests and, on request, the checks an edit needs
write templates and their aliases into the active target when one exists
hint splits for large scan drafts and say when discovery finds nothing
side_effects: writes .flowguard/map.json on scan, deps --write and confirm

components.summary: Check architecture, implementation coverage, model bindings, size and declared replay calls against the current source. Report shape counts as advice without accepted-debt coverage. Treat a newly worded responsibility on the same owner as advice at the shared similarity threshold; retain genuine dropped-owner errors. Reject current-model identity drift while a target copy exists in both check modes, preserving the edit and target on refused promotion. Refuse staged-helper edits, additions or deletions, preserving intent when a legacy helper baseline is unknown. Defer unmatched large_model debts to model execution while retaining static size findings.
responsibilities: check anchors, files, imports, flow steps and models against the code Distinguish legacy fingerprint migration from real source staleness, using the same strict severity. Enforce target commit-seam failures only in strict mode, retaining working-mode and Gitless no-op warnings.
report one owner per entrypoint, responsibility, state and side effect

lint cycles, layers, sizes and private names, then apply only active accepted debts while keeping original record indices; report invalid deadlines as errors and expired deadlines as warnings, or errors in strict checks
explain entrypoints and state writers by model, test or reason
report file and component sizes, duty counts and fan-out as non-gating facts without debt coverage

components.summary: Show complete component/model views, field lifecycles, code ownership, model relations and test positions without importing models. Render actionable owner and binding advice with stable identifiers.
responsibilities: show the tree, Mermaid and digests with static facets and coverage; find owners by word form and rank architecture defects and strengths; compare current and target rules and known-bad definitions by name
find owners by word form and rank architecture defects and strengths
compare current and target facets and list the rules a target changes
show the model rules and flows each component relies on; count process reasons and close review suggestions only with active accepted debts

components.summary: Store owner requests byte for byte and keep immutable request/record identities.
responsibilities: preserve original owner request bytes and sidecars
derive visible request facts without mutable status
